goal: Navigate WhatsApp Web to find customers and broadcast promotions using clicks hovers scrolls and typing
pre_checks: Confirm WhatsApp Web is loaded and left toolbar is visible
Handle any reconnect banner by clicking reload or relink
general_rules: Prefer elements that show a tooltip to confirm identity
Use middle column for discovery scrolling
Scroll thread view only after a chat is open
Use ctrl k to focus search or click the search field

search_chats: press enter or wait for live filter
scroll_chat_list: repeat until target appears or end reached
scroll_thread: scroll right_canvas.thread_view upward to load history as needed
dismiss_banner: if promo banner is visible click its close control

sweep_unread_top_to_bottom: for each visible row do open_chat_row perform required reply return_to_messages
when viewport exhausted scroll_chat_list and continue until none left
deep_scroll_all_chats: loop until bottom reached record last visible title scroll_chat_list if title repeats wait then scroll again
broadcast_to_segment_manual: click chip_all or chip_groups as required
use search to filter by tag prefix in names if applicable
every ten sends pause briefly to avoid rate limits
open_business_shortcuts: use catalog labels quick_replies away_message as needed

hover_confirms: business tools tooltip shows Business tools
advertise tooltip shows Advertise on Facebook
scroll_rules: middle column chat list is scrollable
right canvas thread is scrollable when open
reliability_moves: if click has no effect repeat once after a short wait
if tooltip does not appear re hover
if list lazy load stalls pause then scroll again
if welcome panel is visible you are not in a thread select a chat
safe_exit: to leave any secondary panel click messages
to clear search press escape inside the search field
telemetry_checks: after each navigation confirm expected region is visible
log last action last target and current scroll position of middle column and thread view
